brief--adj.def: Lasting only a short time, or using few words.

punish--verb.def: To make someone suffer for doing wrong.

eternal--adj.def: Lasting for ever, with no end.

tend--verb.def: To usually do something, or to be likely to.
tend--verb.ex: Prices tend to rise in summer.

development--noun.def: The process of growing or becoming more advanced.

global--adj.ex: Climate change is a global problem.

bitter--adj.def: Having a sharp unpleasant taste, or full of resentment.

tent--noun.def: A shelter of cloth held up by poles.
tent--noun.ex: We slept in a small tent.

propose--verb.def: To suggest a plan, or to ask someone to marry you.

survival--noun.def: The state of continuing to live.

connect--verb.ex: Connect the cable to the screen.

beard--noun.def: The hair that grows on a man's chin.

maintain--verb.def: To keep something in good condition or at the same level.

possession--noun.def: Something you own, or the state of having it.
possession--noun.ex: His only possession was a bag.

upper--adj.def: Higher in position than another part.
upper--adj.ex: The upper floors have better light.

tale--noun.def: A story, often an exciting or invented one.

net--noun.def: Material made of crossed threads with holes between.

heal--verb.def: To become healthy again, or to make someone well.
heal--verb.ex: The cut healed in a week.

honeymoon--noun.def: The holiday taken by a newly married couple.
honeymoon--noun.ex: They spent their honeymoon in Bodrum.

appeal--noun.def: An urgent request, or the quality of being attractive.
appeal--noun.ex: The charity made an appeal for blankets.

praise--noun.def: Words that show admiration for someone.

branch--verb.def: To divide into smaller parts or directions.
branch--verb.ex: The road branches near the mill.

muscle--noun.def: The tissue in the body that makes you move.
muscle--noun.ex: He pulled a muscle in his leg.

tense--noun.def: The form of a verb that shows time.

management--noun.def: The people who run a company, or the act of running it.

assignment--noun.def: A piece of work you are given to do.

comedy--noun.def: A film or play that makes people laugh.

facility--noun.def: A building or service provided for a purpose.
facility--noun.ex: The sports facility opens at seven.

remarkable--adj.def: Unusual in a way that deserves attention.

motor--noun.def: The part of a machine that makes it turn.

superior--adj.def: Better in quality or higher in rank.
superior--adj.ex: This wool is superior to cotton.

depressed--adj.def: Very unhappy for a long period.

shortly--adv.def: Soon, after only a short time.

goddess--noun.def: A female god in old religions.
goddess--noun.ex: Athena was a goddess of wisdom.

entry--noun.def: The act of going in, or an item written in a list.

injury--noun.def: Damage to a part of the body.
injury--noun.ex: The injury kept him out for weeks.
injury--noun.exTr: Sakatlık onu haftalarca sahalardan uzak tuttu.

burden--noun.def: A heavy responsibility that is hard to bear.
burden--noun.ex: The debt became a real burden.
burden--noun.exTr: Borç gerçek bir yük hâline geldi.

mount--noun.def: A word used before the name of a mountain.

pound--noun.def: A unit of weight, or British money.

fond--adj.def: Liking someone or something very much.
fond--adj.ex: She is fond of old films.

reception--noun.def: The desk at a hotel, or a formal party.

brick--noun.def: A hard block of baked clay used for building.
brick--noun.ex: The wall is made of brick.

abandon--verb.def: To leave someone or something for ever.

recommend--verb.def: To say that something is good and should be chosen.

concept--noun.ex: The concept is hard to explain.

delay--verb.def: To make something happen later than planned.

soil--verb.ex: The child soiled his new shirt.

baker--noun.def: A person whose job is making bread.
baker--noun.ex: The baker starts work at three.

measure--noun.def: An action taken to solve a problem, or a unit of size.

measure--verb.def: To find the size or amount of something.
measure--verb.ex: Measure the room before you buy.

hip--noun.def: The part of the body between the waist and the leg.
hip--noun.ex: She broke her hip last winter.

function--noun.def: The purpose something has, or what it does.
function--noun.ex: The function of the heart is clear.

foundation--noun.def: The base of a building, or an organization that gives money.
foundation--noun.ex: The foundation of the house cracked.

log--noun.def: A thick piece of cut tree, or a written record.
log--noun.ex: Put another log on the fire.

satellite--noun.def: A machine sent into space to circle the earth.

privacy--noun.def: The state of being free from other people's attention.
privacy--noun.ex: Everyone has a right to privacy.

pub--noun.def: A British place where people drink and talk.
pub--noun.ex: They met at the village pub.

temporary--adj.def: Lasting only for a limited time.

effective--adj.ex: The new method is very effective.

lamb--noun.def: A young sheep, or its meat.

proposal--noun.def: A plan that is formally suggested.

blessing--noun.def: Something you are grateful for, or God's help.

basis--noun.def: The idea or fact that something develops from.
basis--noun.ex: The story has no basis in fact.

recover--verb.def: To become well again, or to get something back.

twist--noun.def: A sudden change in a story or a road.
twist--noun.ex: The film has a clever twist.

twist--verb.def: To turn something around, or to injure a joint.
